messages:
Marina: Quick sync — finalizing release announcement schedule. Need: changelog link, docs URL, canary window, and a short benchmark blurb for the blog.
Sam: working on changelog now, will paste link in a few. FYI canary starts Wed 16:00 PST for 2 hours. ping @Marina once changelog posted.
Li: Webinar slot confirmed for Thurs 9am PT. We'll want a slide with the benchmark 1-slide summary + deep-dive appendix.
Alex: Docs ready except for the new 'routing policy' snippet. I can add by EOD if Sam shares the model/version names.
Sam: changelog uploaded: https://internal.redwood/docs/changelog/3061 — includes model pins and fallback policy. Can anyone review the 'fallback' language?
Marina: reading now… looks good but tighten messaging around data residency — marketing line should say 'optional VPC' not 'VPC only'.
Alex: updated docs with routing snippet and example config block:
```
redwood:
  model: redwood-13b-quant
  fallback: redwood-7b-quant
  routing: region-prefer
```
Sam: perfect. Adding those exact model strings to changelog.
Marina: For the benchmark blurb: keep it high level — "30% token-cost reduction with KV caching and adaptive batching on typical chat loads". We'll link to full benchmarks in blog.
Li: For webinar, could we ask eng to prepare a 3-min demo showing latency before/after? Short demo sells better than slides.
Sam: we can capture before/after traces. I can export latency graphs from staging and annotate.
Marina: Inbound lead routing — marketing wants an answer on when the /contact form will route to sales vs. AE queue. Ops?
Sam: rollout policy will map initial traffic to hosted tier. We'll enable a flag that tags early signups with "pilot-2026" so sales gets a filtered feed. I'll add note in changelog.
Alex: Also adding a docs anchor: https://internal.redwood/docs/release/3061#pilot-2026
Marina: Timeline recap: changelog + docs links by today EOD, canary Wed 16:00-18:00 PST, webinar Thurs 9am PT, public announcement Fri 10:00 PT. Is that green for eng?
Sam: green. I'll push the canary toggle and post deploy-bot confirmation.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled for 2026-03-25T16:00:00-08:00, canary window 2h. See https://ci.redwood/deploys/3061
Marina: Awesome. Last ask — marketer-friendly changelog excerpt for the blog by 9am Thu so comms can finalize hero copy.
Alex: I'll curate a 2-paragraph excerpt from the changelog and a one-line 'what changed' for social.
Marina: thanks team :rocket: We'll circle back if anything slips.
Sam: ping me if you need traces earlier, I can pre-export.
Li: noted. prepping slides.
